critical_code_review_comments: All 6 new Distance Zero Phase 2 features are properly implemented
SLAM Spatial Tracking: 3D room mapping with user positions, face confidence, and auto-frame adjustments
360 Multi-Focus Framing: Panoramic headshot extraction with crop regions and speaking detection
WebXR Spatial Meetings: Vision Pro/Quest 3 support with spatial personas and hand/eye tracking
IoT Room Control: Voice-activated device control with natural language parsing for 'dim lights', 'close shades', presets
Adaptive Beamforming: Directional audio with polar beam pattern visualization and per-user SNR profiles
Meeting Replay: Cinematic director cuts with AI highlight generation in multiple styles
WebXR room-layout endpoint is correctly PUBLIC (no auth required) as per spec
